From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal QBR — 'Stagger + Stitch' roadmap demo (primary + fallback lanes)

Laura —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As we discussed, I want to lock in a compact roadmap demo for the Renewal QBR that gives execs a short, high-level walkthrough while still preserving the technical depth for your engineering and product teams.

Two proposed 60-minute windows (we'll keep the live demo to ~30 min and use the remaining time for Q&A + optional deep-dive):
- Option A: Tue Sep 7, 10:00–11:00 PDT (primary)
- Option B: Tue Sep 7, 16:00–17:00 PDT (staggered fallback in case execs need an alternate band)

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm preferred window and list of must-attend stakeholders (exec + eng + procurement).
- Any redlines/terms procurement wants us to surface during the demo?

Operational note: Marissa — attaching the runbook (Novamed_QBR_runbook_v2.pdf). The plan is a \"stagger + stitch\" play: start with an engine-level product demo and stitch in a 10-min exec summary for leaders who join late; if Novamed execs are unavailable, we flip to a condensed exec recording + live-engineer Q&A in the fallback band. Priyom/Ben, can you each take a fallback ownership lane?

Attachments: Novamed_QBR_runbook_v2.pdf (runbook / timing / presenter contacts)

Thanks,
Markus

--
Markus Klein

Markus —

Thanks — Option A is ideal for the product/eng folks, but our SVP (Carlos) has a calendar conflict 10:30–11:15. If we must pick one slot, Option B works for exec presence, but is later in the day for our EU team.

Quick asks from our side:
- Could you shorten the live demo to 20–25 minutes and save the deep-dive for breakouts? That helps Carlos catch the exec summary before he needs to leave.
- Procurement is preparing a quick list of contract clarifications — I'll send that before EOD Tue Aug 31.

If you do the stagger approach, can you also record the 10-min exec summary so Carlos can watch the short clip if he misses any part?

Appreciate the runbook — looping renewals team to confirm attendees.

Best,
Laura
